title: Length-Maximal Codes with Given Singleton Defect: Structure and Bounds
summary: Let $\mathcal C$ be an $(n,q^k,d)_q$ code of integer dimension $k\ge2$ and Singleton defect $s=n-k+1-d$. Repeated shortening followed by the Plotkin bound gives \[ n\le (s+1)(q+1)+k-2. \] We study the equality case, calling a code attaining this bound \emph{length-maximal}. Equality provides rigid structure: the code is symbol-uniform under every successive shortening, is an orthogonal array of strength at least $k-1$, and has pairwise distances in $\{d\}\cup\{n-k+3,\ldots,n\}$.
